backlash.definition: n. an adverse reaction to some political or social occurrence
backlash.translation:
n. 后冲, 强烈反对
[电] 反撞, 逆栅流

backlasher.translation: n. 后座；反斜线；后冲 (backlash的变形)

backlashes.definition:
-s form of backlash
n. an adverse reaction to some political or social occurrence
backlashes.translation:
(backlash 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 后冲, 强烈反对
[电] 反撞, 逆栅流

backlashing.translation:
n. 反冲；强烈抵制
vt. 强烈反对；发生后冲

backlighted.translation: (backlight 的过去时) vt. 从背后照亮

backlights.translation:

backlog.definition:
n. an accumulation of jobs not done or materials not processed that are yet to be dealt with (especially unfilled customer orders for products or services)
n. the large log at the back of a hearth fire
v. accumulate and create a backlog
backlog.translation:
n. 积压待办的事务, 积压而未交付的订货, 积压的工作
vt. 储备, 把...积压起来
[计] 储备, 后备, 积压

backlogged.translation: 积压（ backlog的过去式和过去分词 ）

backlogging.translation: v. （使）积压( backlog的现在分词 ); 储存; <商>（为日后装运而）登账确认（订货）

backlogs.definition:
n an accumulation of jobs not done or materials not processed that are yet to be dealt with (especially unfilled customer orders for products or services)
n the large log at the back of a hearth fire
n something kept back or saved for future use or a special purpose
v accumulate and create a backlog
backlogs.translation:
n. 积压未办之事( backlog的名词复数 ); 没交付的订货; 备用; 备用物
v. （使）积压( backlog的第三人称单数 ); 储存; <商>（为日后装运而）登账确认（订货）

backlot.translation: n. (电影制片厂的)外景场地

backlund.translation: n. (Backlund)人名；(英)巴克伦；(瑞典)巴克隆德
